title.narrative: Socio-Economic Empowerment through Gender-Responsive Policies, Legislation and Action

description.narrative: The action seeks to contribute towards the accelaration of development of transformative gendeer policies, laws, peace, democratic governance and build effective institutions. The action will further enhance participation of men and women, in decision-making and promote accountable gender-responsive through constitutional amd legal reform,actions to end GBV and empower women.
